limitations: No official four-margin target was yet frozen or calibrated for these runs.
Local persona income_level is unverified generated tier; fixed daily_income_by_aid is a consumption-budget replenishment, not observed personal income.
ID 10대 includes people below 20; its relation to each empirical paper adult/household population needs a declared eligibility mapping.
Resident-person margins cannot be taken from household-income percentages without documented expansion weights.
Matching four marginals does not establish the sex-age-dong-income joint distribution.
